notes: Run each prompt with the skill enabled, with tests/fixtures/viewport-safe.config.json as the brand config (copy it next to the output). Outputs go to a component .tsx file plus the final answer text.

evals.name: hero-with-video
evals.prompt: Build a Framer code component: full-screen hero with a giant headline, a subheading, two CTAs and a 16:9 video on the right.
evals.expected_output: A fit-type hero that passes the required matrix, with contained type, a video box capped on both axes and an above-fold CTA row.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors on the component
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport
the final answer contains the viewport report table with uw-half as the first row
the component starts with a @vs-type header that names the scaling model of the video
the CTA row has data-vs containing above-fold and the hero has data-vs containing fit
a BRAND constant matches tests/fixtures/viewport-safe.config.json
the final answer has one visual-review line per compare sheet

evals.name: gsap-horizontal-gallery
evals.prompt: Build a pinned horizontal scroll gallery of 8 property cards using GSAP ScrollTrigger.
evals.expected_output: A scroll-scene whose card height comes from svh with a px cap and a width bound, ScrollTrigger distances as functions measured from the section.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors on the component
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport
ScrollTrigger end is a function using the section's width (not window.innerWidth) and invalidateOnRefresh is true
card height is bounded by svh, a px maximum and a width-derived bound
the final answer contains the viewport report table with uw-half as the first row

evals.name: sticky-stacking-cards
evals.prompt: Build a sticky stacking cards section, 5 cards that stack as you scroll.
evals.expected_output: A scroll-scene whose sticky cards have max-height from svh minus the top offset, passing C2 at every scroll step.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors on the component
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport
each sticky card has a max-height derived from 100svh minus its top offset
the final answer contains the viewport report table with uw-half as the first row

evals.name: fix-broken-hero-wide
evals.prompt: Here is our existing component (tests/fixtures/BrokenHero.tsx). Make it work on my manager's monitor.
evals.expected_output: A fixed copy that keeps the design and passes the required matrix; the answer shows before/after results.
assertions: the fixed component has 0 lint errors
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport on the fixed component
the answer reports the original failing at uw-full, uw-29 and laptop-125 before the fix
height: 100vh with overflow: hidden is replaced by min-height: 100svh
the final answer contains the viewport report table with uw-half as the first row

evals.name: stats-band-no-overengineering
evals.prompt: Build a stats band with 4 big numbers that count up when in view.
evals.expected_output: A simple grow section: fixed px/rem type in a content container, no viewport units and no fit token.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors and 0 warnings
viewport-audit --matrix quick passes
the header says @vs-type grow
the component uses no vw, vh or svh units and no data-vs="fit"
the final answer contains the viewport report table

evals.name: threejs-ring-hero
evals.prompt: Build a full-screen hero with a Three.js ring of gold bars on the right and the headline on the left.
evals.expected_output: A hero whose 3D ring stays fully visible at uw-half and uw-half-stress, through an aspect-aware camera or an aspect-locked stage, with a key-visual proxy.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport
C7 reports the key-visual proxy fully visible at uw-half and uw-half-stress (no C7 finding)
the code uses containCamera/ContainCamera or an aspect-locked stage, and the answer names which
a transparent data-vs="key-visual" proxy element tracks the ring

evals.name: fix-broken-tall-hero
evals.prompt: My manager snaps his browser to half of his ultrawide and this hero breaks (tests/fixtures/BrokenTallHero.tsx). Fix it.
evals.expected_output: A fixed copy that passes uw-half and uw-half-stress; the ring is contained and the showreel no longer overflows.
assertions: the fixed component has 0 lint errors
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport, with no C9 warning at uw-half or uw-half-stress
the answer reports the original failing at uw-half and uw-half-stress (C1, C9) and passing at design
the fix uses an aspect-locked stage, a contain camera or a safe-zone layout, and the answer says which
HeightLockedScene.tsx is unchanged

evals.name: height-locked-embed-hero
evals.prompt: Use tests/fixtures/HeightLockedScene.tsx (it stands in for our Unicorn Studio embed) as a full-screen hero with our headline and CTA on the left.
evals.expected_output: A hero that places the scene in an aspect-locked stage (or equivalent) so the ring is never cropped, with a proxy key visual.
assertions: lint-sizing reports 0 errors on the new component
viewport-audit --matrix required passes every required viewport, with no C9 warning
the scene sits in a box with the 1440/900 aspect ratio contained by both axes, or the answer justifies another approach
a data-vs="key-visual" proxy covers the ring
HeightLockedScene.tsx is unchanged
